title: Deformation of an integer multiplicity current onto the n-skeleton (Simon 6.5.1, (1)–(25))
statement: Assume, as hypotheses of the statement, (VO) the frozen type of Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support: for all P, n, U, S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) with tsupport ω disjoint from spt S, S(ω) = 0; (MR) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: for U open and an IMRep R representing T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every open W; (REP) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_exists_massRepresentation: for U open and T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) with M_W(T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U there are a Borel measure μ (μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, finite on compact subsets of U) and ξ (μ-a.e. strongly measurable, |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for all x, α) with M_W(T) = μ(W) for open W, T(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ, and, if also M_W(∂T) < ∞ for open W ⊂⊂ U, μ(E) = 0 whenever Hⁿ(E) = 0; (IMC) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub: (a) locality of approximate tangent spaces for Borel M ⊆ M' ⊆ U with Hⁿ(M' ∩ K) < ∞ (K ⊆ U compact); (b) the restriction (M ∩ E, θ, ξ) of an IMRep to a Borel E is an IMRep representing some current; (c) A − B is integer multiplicity for integer multiplicity A, B (U open); (d) |R.orient(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for Hⁿ-a.e. x in the carrier; (SL) the frozen type of Submission.cmc_slice_mass_bounds: for T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) and ∂T represented by measures (μ, ξ), (μ', ξ') with |ξ|, |ξ'| ≤ 1 a.e. and f L-Lipschitz there are A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' with ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) when tsupport η misses {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) and ∫⁻_{(a,b)} M_W(∂A_t − B_t)dt ≤ L·μ(W ∩ {a < f < b}). (These are exactly the frozen Lean types of the parent node's resolved dependencies, written as antecedents so that the child does not need those declarations; the parent instantiates them.) For all P, m ∈ ℕ (n := m + 1) there is c ∈ ℝ≥0 with c ≥ 1 such that for every integer multiplicity T ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (domain univ) with compact support, M(T) < ∞ and M(∂T) < ∞ there are Q₀ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P), R₁ ∈ 𝒟_{n+1}(ℝ^P) and S₁ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with: Q₀ and R₁ integer multiplicity; T − Q₀ − S₁ = ∂R₁; spt Q₀ ⊆ L_n := {x : there is a set s of coordinate indices with P ≤ n + |s| and x_i ∈ ℤ for i ∈ s} (the n-skeleton of the unit cubical grid); M(Q₀) ≤ cM(T), M(∂Q₀) ≤ cM(∂T), M(R₁) ≤ cM(T), M(S₁) ≤ cM(∂T); spt Q₀ ∪ spt R₁ ⊆ cthickening(√P, spt T) and spt ∂Q₀ ∪ spt S₁ ⊆ cthickening(√P, spt ∂T) (Metric.cthickening, the closed thickening {x : dist(x, A) ≤ √P}).
